title.value: Systematic Generalization by Finetuning? Analyzing Pretrained Language Models Using Constituency Tests
title.justification: The title straightforwardly reflects the content of the paper, which is an investigation into the ability of pretrained language models to generalize through finetuning, using constituency tests as the method of analysis.
title.quote: Systematic Generalization by Finetuning? Analyzing Pretrained Language Models Using Constituency Tests

extractions.description: This paper investigates the ability of pretrained language models, specifically BART and T5, to replicate linguistic constituency tests after finetuning. The study is grounded in the concept of systematic generalization, which is assessed through various syntactic transformations in sentence structures such as clefting and wh-question formation. The findings suggest that these language models often rely on surface-level cues rather than deep linguistic understanding, which affects their performance on novel data.
